name: creel
desc: An old rope-splicer in his seventies who has worked the same stair-town all his life: weather-beaten and slow-moving, deep-set eyes under white brows, a short white stubble beard, a bald crown with white hair over the ears, big knuckled hands scarred by cordage. He wears a pale oatmeal fisherman's jumper under a faded olive canvas waistcoat, a rope belt, and a splicing fid and marlinspike on a lanyard at his chest; a half-spliced hank of hemp rope rests in his hands. Grounded, unhurried, kind.
sheetHint: stooped and slow, white stubble beard, bald crown with white side hair, oatmeal fisherman's jumper, faded olive canvas waistcoat, splicing fid on a lanyard, hank of rope in hands
